To both parties: the contested charge is the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee on trip TRP-02710 (EV-FARE-02710: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). It is refunded in full to the rider.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Each draft's own explanation

To both parties: the contested charge is the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee on trip TRP-02710 (EV-FARE-02710: cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). It is refunded in full to the rider. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. Limbs (b) and (c) both fail on the driver's own trace (EV-GPS-02710, weight 1.0, COMPLETE, 100% coverage, 64 fixes, no gaps). The closest of the 64 driver fixes to the Bedok Interchange pickup pin is 517.41 m, against a TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius of 150 m (POL-NS-02; fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m), and the derived arrival block records 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes with a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s. POL-NS-02 therefore is not met — there is no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the trip — so the driver is not deemed to have arrived and limb (b) fails. Limb (c) fails as well: effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), a 180 s shortfall, and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full on that arithmetic whether or not the rider was present. The driver's 'arrived' marker at 22:48:55 does not save the charge. Under POL-NS-05 that marker is FALSE: at that timestamp the driver was necessarily more than 300 m from the pin (his nearest fix in the whole trace is 517.41 m), and the trace also shows speeds of 57–63 km/h, i.e. a vehicle in motion. Recomputing the waiting clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix yields none, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies: full refund, no compensation, and a false-arrival entry against the driver.
